title: Creepet Takeover
description: Creepers look so terrifying! With this resource pack you can make them seem a lot friendlier and make you hug him! But it would be a total mistake if you try to do that. But hey, cute!
body:
![Creepet Takeover](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ebcbc571ea479c03bd2c0e4742b659a2e2607fac.png)

#

![REQUIRES OPTIFINE!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/90e2084af6126b4f1abd75a8549bbfe1b8f861bd.png)

## What does it change?

Well you see... Creepers are scary (not really), but they dont have to be, so i made this resource pack, to change this terryfing creature to a cute little creeper, i called him **Creepet** :)

## Does it work without Optifine?

Yes, with Optifine, you have a custom model, without Optifine, it just changes the texture of the creeper

## What happened after you letted your cousin change your giant steve?

He made Steve have diabeties
